entry.title: I Ran My Business With AI for 30 Days: Results and Lessons

entry.title: AI keeps getting blamed for tech layoffs, but the numbers don't really line up
entry.summary: I keep seeing "AI took these jobs" every time a company does layoffs, and I'm not convinced it's the main driver. A few things I keep coming back to. The industry cut around 122,500 jobs in 2025, down from about 153,000 in 2024. AI was named as a direct reason in fewer than 8% of those announcements. entry.title: Most Companies Don't Have an AI Problem. They Have a Decision-Making Problem.
entry.summary: Most companies don't have an AI problem—they have a decision-making problem. AI amplifies existing organizational behaviors; it doesn't fix broken processes. Companies with unclear ownership, conflicting metrics, and slow decision-making often struggle to realize value from AI investments.
